notes.title: HWR: Reforged — Sins of the Floating City. New DLC announcement and release date.
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/fbf8267353a5507ad8ab002b19eec99774c9ea3f.png"]

Hello everyone!

We are happy to finally make an official announcement of Heads Will Roll: Reforged's fourth DLC — Sins of the Floating City. It is scheduled to be released on September 4th 10am PDT and will continue to expand the world and story of HWR. This time with two new massive story branches that will be taking place in Italy during Venice-Genoa wars. As always, the DLC will be accompanied by a major patch containing new items, gameplay mechanics, updated balancing and lots of technical iprovements.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City"][/dynamiclink]
What awaits you in the DLC:

*No step too far, no measure too desperate
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

*A descent into darkness
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/badef4b721b81d14272c5722cff02a99c10b10c7.jpg"]

*More than a dozen new characters
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

*Europe-spanning adventure
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

*2 new romantic interests
Each with their own unique story and character.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/de5a0f1403bd320b2b6a6b6698af6a006edf6ad3.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/1243e4136a45c7845858c8fafd31d6732032bab6.jpg"]

As always together with the DLC we will be releasing a big gameplay update that will, among other things, include:

• new mechanics, items, weapons and civic talents;

• improved survival mode;

• a lot of bugfixes and several performance improvements;

notes.title: MMS: Patch #3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/beec01dcb615915c9cd59ed5694dd04f38846f8a.png

Hello mechanics!

Today we are releasing the next hotfix patch for Mech Mechanic Simulator. Most of the issues fixed here were pointed out to us by you, our community. Thank you for all the reports!

The patch introduces:

The issue with accepting contract work and working on a garage mech has been resolved.
The trophy case should now correctly display rewards gathered for completing the hardest missions.
The screen settings now feature a Field of View slider.
You can now use the W, S, A and D keys to adjust waves during scanning.
The stock market share prices have been increased greatly increased.
With the increase of share prices the stock bonus award from missions has been lowered.
The amount of shares you can own is now limited by your reputation level (each corporation separately).
All players that managed to buy a large number of shares before this patch went live will receive a special achievement as a thank you for finding this exploit.
You can now perform a jump during the Agility calibration a few moments after you start falling.
Pressing space (without holding) will now cause the mech to jump higher during the Agility calibration.
Wall running during the Agility calibration now detects the player faster and lasts longer.
Sliding during the Agility calibration now lasts longer.
Multiple small issues with part assembly order have been fixed for Artemis, Hana and Wrath.
Insanely large amounts of money will no longer cause the number to drop to 0 and trigger the bankruptcy event.
The Depth of Field during mech assembly has been reduced.
The main menu now has an FPS cap (when playing without VSync).


We hope this patch will make the game more enjoyable!

notes.title: MMS: Patch #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/beec01dcb615915c9cd59ed5694dd04f38846f8a.png

Hello mechanics!

What a day it's been! Mech Mechanic Simulator is finally live and since release we've seen a lot of suggestions from you. We want to thank you all for your continuous feedback and support!

Today, the team was hard at work to iron out a few of the most reported issues spotted by you, our players.

This patch introduces a few fixes and balance changes:


The Electronics Station tutorial will no longer block you from finishing it if you restart the game before completing it.
The Software Station tutorial now doesn't cause a job failure because of downgrading the software of a mech. Outside of the tutorial that rule still applies.
The Agility Calibration now charges the Jump action faster (holding Space).
The Combat Calibration turrets and drones deal less damage.
The Mining Calibration flamethrowers now heat up the mech slower.
The additional payment for finishing a Calibration has been increased.
Parts will no longer spin during the Decorrosion and Welding process when a gamepad or joystick is connected.
Multiple small optimization changes were made.

We do hope that this patch will make the game much more enjoyable!

notes.title: MMS: Prologue Patch #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/9840988427878b5769cddce989768864cd979d03.png

Hello Mechanics!

While we are nearing the release of the Mech Mechanic Simulator full version we decided to patch the Prologue and apply the changes made for the release.

The changes introduced in this patch are:

 A new station has been added to the game: the tablet, which gives you access to the jobs menu from anywhere in the workshop („T” key).
 The scanning process has been completely redesigned and now requires you to adjust the scanner waves to the mech.
 The issue causing short freezes while travelling through the workshop has been resolved.
 The „replace part with a new one” objectives now have a very high chance to feature repaired parts instead of completely broken ones.
 The “repair part” additional objectives are no longer shown as the main objectives in the assembly station.
 The colour used to highlight the job objective parts has been changed to make it easier to spot.
 The parts that can be removed and those that block the disassembly now feature a new visual effect making them easier to spot.
 The prices of parts and stations have been changed to reflect the final game balance.
 The welding station now features a new tutorial explaining the process better.
 The welding station now calculates the part durability based on the precision of highlighting welding areas.
 The fuel of the welding station now drains much slower.
 The fuel of the cleaning station now drains faster.
 The tutorial is now more streamlined and shouldn’t cause the reported issues.
 Multiple smaller issues with the tutorial have been fixed.
 The sun now again creates god rays in the workshop.
 The android now asks you to buy a mechanics license after hitting 30,000$.
 Multiple mechs had their assembly order fixed to no longer block you from putting parts back.
 Several colours used on the mechs and in the painting station have been readjusted to no longer blend with other highlights.
We hope that these changes will make Mech Mechanic Simulator: Prologue a much more enjoyable experience.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1485350/Mech_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Demo patch #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/6812d6f8d44d721f6ac8229d1533cf91cd6610fb.png

Hello Mechanics! ːsteamhappyː

What a weekend it’s been! We’ve been looking at your comments, videos, streams and taking notes. Today we are introducing the first patch to the demo version (which will of course also transfer to the upcoming prologue and full version).

The patch fixes three major issues reported to us:


 The android can now be muted (outside of the tutorial) using the sound settings. Just un-tick the “Android” setting to remove his vocal module.
 The time between the androids' comments has been increased. He will no longer spam you with endless chatter and he will no longer repeat himself constantly.
 The screen settings now feature a “Brightness” slider making it possible to increase or decrease the brightness of the game.


While this patch is a small one we felt like these issues needed a quick fix to boost the enjoyment of the demo. We are working on more improvements for the prologue and full version based on all your feedback.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts on Mech Mechanic Simulator and we hope to hear more from you. ːsteamthumbsupː
